ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the calendar. When it matches a stored calendar, that calendar is updated. Otherwise a new calendar is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

TimeZoneId.description: Time zone the weekly schedule and holidays are evaluated in. When empty, UTC is used.

Day.description: The day of the week this window applies to.

IsOpen.description: Whether the queue is open on this day.

OpenMinute.description: Local time, in minutes from midnight, the open window starts.

CloseMinute.description: Local time, in minutes from midnight (exclusive), the open window ends.

WeeklySchedule.description: Per-day open windows that define the weekly schedule.

Holidays.description: Dates the queue is closed all day regardless of the weekly schedule.

Enabled.description: Whether the calendar is enabled. Disabled calendars do not gate routing.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the calendar, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Calendars.description: The Contact Center business-hours calendars to create or update.
